claims.text: Limina publishes peer-reviewed UAP studies under DOI prefix 10.59661, including Ammon (January 2024), Szydagis (March 2025), Grosvenor, Hancock & Porritt on the US atomic warfare complex (March 2025) and Houran on government-sourced UAP data (July 2026).
